text:
```yaml
name: Check AI Co-Authors

on:
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  check-co-authors:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - name: Checkout repository
      uses: actions/checkout@v2

    - name: Set up Python
      uses: actions/setup-python@v2
      with:
        python-version: '3.x'

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        pip install --upgrade pip
        pip install shellcheck yamllint actionlint

    - name: Validate .github/workflows/check-ai-co-authors.yml
      run: yamllint .github/workflows/check-ai-co-authors.yml

    - name: Validate .github/scripts/check-ai-co-authors.sh
      run: shellcheck .github/scripts/check-ai-co-authors.sh

    - name: Run AI Co-Author Checker
      run: .github/scripts/check-ai-co-authors.sh
      env:
        GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
```
